findings.desc: .claude/hooks/session-brief-reminder.cjs:78 only reads .koala/activity.jsonl and root docs/story/activity.jsonl, but the existing Claude PostToolUse logger records story-branch Bash activity under docs/story/actives/<storyId>/activity.jsonl. WHY: after a normal Claude Bash run of koala session_brief in a story worktree, UserPromptSubmit can still think there is no fresh heartbeat and keep warning on every prompt. severity: high

.claude/hooks/session-brief-reminder.cjs:78 misses the actual Claude Bash activity path used by .claude/hooks/log-tools.cjs:36; a fresh story-branch Bash `koala session_brief` is written to docs/story/actives/<storyId>/activity.jsonl, but the reminder hook only checks .koala/activity.jsonl and docs/story/activity.jsonl, so the next UserPromptSubmit still prints the reminder. Repro: temp root with docs/story/actives/B-demo/activity.jsonl containing fresh Bash detail `koala session_brief` produced `建议先运行 koala session_brief 恢复现场`. This leaves CHK-003 edge behavior / recorded evidence partially unimplemented.
